ledger.summary: The lady kisses the stirring Ralph and tells him she was the cloaked youth at the Flower de Luce and in the escape, entering the Burg with her captain of war to free four friends. The Knight of the Sun disarms Ralph as his prisoner and sends him for the horses. Walter the Black proves alive; the lady dresses his wound and says only her hand and learning can save him. With no food, they must wait; Ralph finds bread, meat and wine in Walter's saddle-bags; the lady makes Walter a bracken bed.
ledger.geography_notes: The knights' horses are a hundred yards into the wood in line from the oak tree.
